selectionRule: Same declared December circulars as the frozen PKV experiment, all five origins and all three prospective years. No selection based on scores.
mapping: Annual tax = observed opening tax times cumulative national nominal tax-base growth. This assumes a constant local share and constant tax rate. No additional local demographic multiplier. Existing grant path stays unchanged, including its original illustrative equalisation term.
limitations: National tax-base growth is not a municipal tax-revenue forecast.
Opening tax includes tax settlements; no separate settlement forecast or recurring tax-base reconciliation in this diagnostic.
Rule changes in tax deductions can be compensated through general grants. Those compensations are deliberately not added in this tax-only sensitivity.
Constant local share removes endogenous local demographic tax response from this sensitivity; it is not a validated policy-response model.
The annual opening accounts remain retrospective revised inputs. Dated circulars do not make this a real-time replay.
Sources read via web PDF/indexed text. Original PDF bytes are not archived; attempted screenshots were unavailable.
